title: Final Decay State
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the decay from the p-wave state to the s-wave state.

title: Decay Matrix Element
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct form of the decay matrix element involving the electric dipole interaction.

title: Limit as Epsilon Goes to Zero
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain that as epsilon approaches zero, the decay matrix element approaches zero, indicating no decay occurs.

title: Metastable State Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student must mention that the s-wave state is metastable and cannot decay via electric dipole transition.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid errors related to the incorrect identification of allowed transitions or misapplying selection rules.
